driver_of_the_day.label: +10.9 pts v expected
driver_of_the_day.why: Lando Norris scored 25 from P1 on the grid; the model expected 14.1.

best_drive_from_back.label: P18 to P9
best_drive_from_back.why: Fernando Alonso gained 9 places from P18 in the 11th-fastest car.

best_strategy.label: +7.5 places through the stops
best_strategy.why: Sergio Pérez's 3-stop race cost 7.5 fewer places in the pit windows than the race's average stop.

fastest_stop.label: 12.0 s in the pit lane
fastest_stop.why: Quickest trip through the pit lane, lap 8 (no stationary times published).

overtake_of_race.label: on Lando Norris, lap 5
overtake_of_race.why: Andrea Kimi Antonelli passed Lando Norris for P1 on lap 5 despite being +0.55 s/lap slower on corrected pace.

unluckiest.label: 8.3 points lost
unluckiest.why: Out on lap 1 with a retirement (cause not published); the forecast had him on 8.3 points.

smoothest.label: 0.335 s lap-time sd
smoothest.why: Andrea Kimi Antonelli's corrected clean laps varied by just 0.335 s (1 sd).

team_of_weekend.label: +8.2 pts v expected
team_of_weekend.why: McLaren's drivers beat the model's expectation by 8.2 points combined.
